fields.description: FOO = Food Grade, CHM = Chemical. Boleh dikosongkan — tank yang peruntukannya belum ditetapkan tidak dicap.
fields.label: Equipment Type

fields.description: Tank yang masih dipakai. Nonaktifkan kalau sudah dijual / scrap / keluar armada — riwayatnya tetap, tapi tank tidak muncul lagi di pilihan booking, plan, maupun import.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Tanggal periodic test terakhir dari data plate tank. Diisi manual.
fields.label: Last Test Date

fields.description: Depot & Shipper diisi manual. Status dan Inventory Stage dihitung otomatis dari order yang masih terbuka (EIR, Cleaning Order, Repair Order) — lihat container_status.container_open_orders.
fields.label: Status Operasional (otomatis)

fields.description: Shipper for the current release cycle.
fields.label: Shipper

fields.description: Monitoring stage derived from Status (auto-maintained). Pre-Arrival and Departed are excluded from in-depo stock.
fields.label: Inventory Stage

fields.description: Distempel otomatis saat EIR-In / EIR-Out disubmit, Order Bongkar disubmit, dan saat penagihan storage dijalankan.
fields.label: Riwayat Gate & Kargo (otomatis)

fields.description: Arrival vessel, copied from the most recent Order Bongkar when it is submitted.
fields.label: Ex Vessel

fields.description: Watermark: storage already billed up to this date. Advanced by consolidated billing so re-runs never double-charge storage days.
fields.label: Storage Billed Until

fields.description: Jejak dokumen lain yang menyentuh tank ini. Semua read-only.
fields.label: Referensi Order Lain (otomatis)

fields.description: Set when this Container master was auto-created as a pre-arrival reservation for an Container Booking (Tank In, container not yet in the system). On that booking's cancellation, the phantom is deleted if it never gated in; pre-existing containers are only reverted to Available.
fields.label: Created by Booking

fields.description: Order Bongkar terakhir yang memuat tank ini.
fields.label: Order Bongkar

fields.description: Container Booking (Tank Out) yang menandai target lift-on ini (jejak).
fields.label: Booking Lift-On

fields.description: Rencana lift-on (gate out) dari booking keluar yang aktif. Mendorong prioritas urutan kerja cleaning / M&R. Diisi otomatis — bukan isian manual.
fields.label: Target Lift-On

fields.description: Letak terakhir tank, dicatat lewat menu Letak Tank di PWA (doctype Container Position). Read-only di sini: yang menulis adalah catatan letaknya, bukan sebaliknya — supaya "kapan " dan "oleh siapa" selalu punya dokumen di belakangnya.
fields.label: Letak Tank di Yard
Letak Terakhir
fields.description: Catatan bebas letak tank (mis. "blok kanan dekat pos, tumpukan 2"). Ditulis oleh Container Position; kosong = belum pernah didata.
Kapan letak itu terakhir dicatat. Ini yang dibaca Survey Order untuk bilang seberapa segar posisinya.
fields.label: Letak Diperbarui

fields.description: Legacy (unused): the depot no longer maps tanks to yard zones.
fields.label: Yard Zone

fields.description: Riwayat nomor seal tiap kali tank keluar depo — dibaca langsung dari EIR-Out, tidak disimpan di master (jadi tidak bisa basi). Nomor seal diinput di EIR-Out saat tank dilepas.
fields.label: Seals
